system.description: Whether by accident or the deliberate action of a rival, your name and every trace of your existence have been wiped from the earth. No one remembers your name, no writing speaks of you, and no mortal descendant or vampire progeny bears it. In Egyptian tradition you have become a non-entity; despite your very physical presence, as far as the rest of your clan is concerned, you no longer exist. You have no status within the clan, nor will any progeny you create. Indeed, any Setite who encounters you is obligated to diablerize you and return Set's vitae to his remaining children, and any wealth, land or property in your possession may be taken from you by other Setites without fear of retribution.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents
